title: 地味なアプリだが、タスクによってはtodoリスト系より便利。
body:
必ずやらなければいけない系のタスクはtodoリスト系アプリがいいと思うが、「2週間経ったし、そろそろ金魚の水を換えなきゃな〜」みたいなタスクには最適。こういうタスクをtodoで管理すると未達成が増えてしまい、重要なタスクが埋もれたりします。
一方でこのアプリを使えば、「あ、歯医者をサボってたら1年半経っちゃった、、、流石にやばいな」みたいな感じで予約しようと思えて、とっても便利です。

title: The perfect blend of simplicity and function
body:
This is arguably the best approach to a simple utility like a day counter. Other developers would clog the interface with ads or force you to subscribe to Sobriety Plus after a 7-day free trial. Not these folks. This app is elegant, well designed, and like a pen knife, does exactly what it needs to and not much else.

If you need to track how long it’s been since you’ve done things, even a bunch of different things, this is the app for you. Whether it’s time since you guiltily ate a whole bag of chips, time since you cleaned the kitchen, or time since you worked on that creative project you mean to finish, this app will tell you how long it’s been *and that’s it!* No frills, no fuss. It’s brilliant.

title: Easy to Use, Clean Looking App, Feels like an Apple App
body:
I was looking for an app that makes me accountable for my vices, mainly alcohol and tobacco.

The app itself has no set up time, ready to use on the get go, and not learning curve at all.

The UI elements looks like the iOS ui didn’t felt like I downloaded a third party app.

title: Works great!
body: It's very nice, works great, and modern. Shortcuts also works well! I have a request, can you add a counter that continues instead of resets? For example, if I want to do and keep track of my workouts every day, I want press a button like"I did it today" after workouts each day. In other words, I want an option that is the opposite of what this app currently have, like keeping track of what and when we have done. Anyway thanks for the great app!
